title: Algebraic Structure of Three-Flavor Neutrino Oscillations in Constant-Density Matter: Cayley--Hamilton Evolution, DMP Resummation, and Closed-Form Uncertainty Propagation
summary: For three-flavor neutrino oscillations in constant-density matter, the Cayley--Hamilton theorem forces the evolution operator into a quadratic polynomial in $\hat{H}$, with coefficients determined by the three real eigenvalues through a Vandermonde system we write out explicitly. The eigenvalues follow from Cardano's trigonometric formula, recovering the Zaglauer--Schwarzer expressions.
